1376862206638325764.a:
Switching from vegetable oils to nut oils made the most drastic improvement to my health. BP was 165/110; now 130/70. That means you have to cook most of your food from scratch. You don't have to give up beef but 100g/day (4oz) is plenty. Load up on vegetables/fruit to feel full. Tweet by @medical_xpress

https://x.com/medical_xpress/status/1376860539951980548

1376864247590834179.a: Another thing I found useful is to mix sucrose (table sugar) or honey or HFCS 50/50 with glucose (light corn syrup). Glucose acts instantly so you don't overconsume sugars so easily. Fructose takes hours to digest, sucrose is faster, but glucose will absorb in your mouth/stomach.

1376864768087179264.a: If you mix protein, carbohydrates, fructose, and glucose at the right ratios you will have energy for much longer periods. Stick to a schedule. It is critical that you eat the right things at the right times. Talk to a nutritionist. Some groceries (Kroger) offer free consults.

1376865956274733064.a: When I cook beef, for example, I add a little coconut or sesame oil. Why? You need all fatty acids in the right ratios. Fry veggies in water. Fry meats in nut oils. See if your doctor is able to test vitamins/minerals in your blood to verify what you need to change or supplement.
